hooks.command: echo '[CONTEXT LIMIT REACHED] Before compacting, spawn a sub-agent to create a handoff document. Use: Task tool with subagent_type=handoff-creator and prompt: Create a handoff document for the current session. After the sub-agent completes, proceed with /compact.'

statusLine.command:
input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); short_dir=$(echo "$cwd" | sed "s|^$HOME|~|"); if [[ $(echo "$short_dir" | grep -o "/" | wc -l) -gt 2 ]]; then short_dir="...$(echo "$short_dir" | rev | cut -d'/' -f1,2 | rev)"; fi; git_info=""; if cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "detached"); status_output=$(git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); staged_added=$(echo "$status_output" | grep -c '^A'); staged_deleted=$(echo "$status_output" | grep -c '^D'); staged_modified=$(echo "$status_output" | grep -c '^[MRC]'); unstaged_added=$(echo "$status_output" | grep -c '^.A'); unstaged_deleted=$(echo "$status_output" | grep -c '^.D'); unstaged_modified=$(echo "$status_output" | grep -c '^.M'); untracked=$(echo "$status_output" | grep -c '^??'); dirty_mark=""; if [ "$staged_added" -gt 0 ] || [ "$staged_deleted" -gt 0 ] || [ "$staged_modified" -gt 0 ] || [ "$unstaged_added" -gt 0 ] || [ "$unstaged_deleted" -gt 0 ] || [ "$unstaged_modified" -gt 0 ] || [ "$untracked" -gt 0 ]; then dirty_mark="*"; fi; staged_str=$(printf "staged[+%d -%d ~%d]" "$staged_added" "$staged_deleted" "$staged_modified"); unstaged_str=$(printf "unstaged[+%d -%d ~%d]" "$unstaged_added" "$unstaged_deleted" "$unstaged_modified"); untracked_str=$(printf "?%d" "$untracked"); if [ -n "$dirty_mark" ]; then branch_color="\033[33m"; else branch_color="\033[32m"; fi; git_info=$(printf " %b%s%s\033[0m \033[32m%s\033[0m \033[33m%s\033[0m \033[2m%s\033[0m" "$branch_color" "$branch" "$dirty_mark" "$staged_str" "$unstaged_str" "$untracked_str"); fi; if [ -n "$git_info" ]; then printf '
\033[36m%s\033[0m%s
' "$short_dir" "$git_info"; else printf '
\033[36m%s\033[0m
' "$short_dir"; fi
